video.description: A bloom of the spectrum. Each frequency band throws a coloured ray as far out as it is loud, an audio steered current carries the ink away from the centre, and the frame folds into five slowly turning sectors. Amount and Trail set how much ink is laid down and how long it lingers, Hue and Spread place the palette on the colour wheel, Flow and Swirl set how fast and how wildly the current moves, Swing sets how far the music is allowed to steer it, and the Kaleido group sets how much of the fold is kept, how many sectors and rings it is cut into, and how fast it turns.
video.name: Spectral Bloom

video.description: Still dark water struck by the music. A real wave equation runs under the picture: every onset drops a ring, the rings expand, reflect off the walls and interfere. Bass hits drop a wide ring near the middle, mids and highs scatter smaller ones further out, and the surface is drawn from its own curvature, so a thin bright line rides exactly on each wavefront. Each band and the strike threshold judge themselves against their own recent peak, so quiet material rings the tank as surely as loud. Speed and Stillness set how fast the water carries and how long it rings. Colors Low, Mid and High are the colors the bass, middle and treble ripples take, and Range sets how far apart they pull: at zero every ripple is Mid and the pool is tinted from that one swatch, as it was before.
video.name: Spectral Drops

video.description: An audio reactive eclipse. Each frequency band throws a ray out from behind a dark disc, as far as that band is loud, while a bright limb burns on the edge of the disc and the whole corona turns slowly and trails behind itself. Reach sets how far the rays carry, Eclipse the size of the disc, Sharpness how hard its edge is and Limb how thick the burning ring is, Detail how finely each ray is feathered. Hue and Spread place the palette on the colour wheel.
video.name: Spectral Eclipse
